_comment: Mochi test config, pass 2: height-axis fix, mesh hygiene (validator-equivalent self-check), detail pieces kept (whiskers/bell), larger bake extrusion + hole fill.
_source_up_axis_note: glTF is +Y up by spec; Blender's glTF importer converts to Z-up.
_source_units_note: glTF units are metres, but the GLB measures 1.56 m tall x 1.54 m wide x 1.69 m deep (Blender Z-up), a nonsensical size for a house cat (generated meshes come out normalised to ~1.5-2 units). Rescaled to a chosen 30 cm sitting height (plausible domestic cat, head + ears). This is a guess, not a measurement: needs human confirmation of the intended in-game size.
_bake_source_note: 0 = bake from the full-resolution sculpt. Set e.g. 2000000 to pre-decimate the bake source if RAM is tight.

retopo._quadriflow_note: QuadriFlow is run on a copy scaled so its largest dimension equals each solve height in turn (Blender's pre-check rejects small real-world-sized meshes); first height that QuadriFlow accepts wins.

keep_detail._note: Source faces > 1% of height away from the remeshed body, in edge-connected pieces of >= 8 faces (whiskers, bell, ...), are appended to LOD0 as separate thin geometry inside the LOD0 budget; carried to lower LODs only while they fit 25% of that LOD's budget.

ao._note: AO is baked from the high-poly onto LOD0 into ORM.R; roughness (G) and metallic (B) are constants, not measured.

_asset_name_note: null = derived from the input file stem (sanitised for Unreal names). Override with --asset-name or by setting this key.
_units_manual_step: Source size was not trusted (1.56 m tall at glTF metres) and was rescaled to a chosen 30 cm height; confirm the intended in-game cat size.
_lods_note: Source is already 2,680 tris, below a typical hero LOD0 (8-12k). LOD0 budget = 3,000 (no up-res), LOD1-3 halve from there.
